sources.description: Invented case records; review classifications are stipulated inputs, not legal findings.
Bounded educational modeling decisions and admission policy; not a quotation or claim of complete legal or clinical requirements.

assertions.meaning: Admitted evidence relation record.
Admitted evidence relation governs.
Admitted evidence relation uses.
Admitted evidence relation part.
Admitted evidence relation member.
Conclusions about permits must be derived.
Conclusions about entitled must be derived.
Conclusions about obliged must be derived.
Reviewed health-data classification implies the special-category classification.
Reviewed special-category data is personal data.

assertions.statement: all $case, $data, $subject: record($case, $data, $subject, CaseRegister) & member($data, SpecialCategoryData) -> member($case, SpecialCategoryCases).
assertions.meaning: The case inherits the classification of its explicitly linked records.

assertions.statement: all $c, $case: governs($c, $case) & member($case, ApplicableGDPRCases) & member($case, ConsentReviewComplete) & member($case, ValidConsentRecorded) & ~member($case, ConsentWithdrawalRecorded) -> permits($c, $case, Article6Consent).
assertions.meaning: A reviewed active consent supports this case's consent route; this is not all-GDPR compliance.

assertions.statement: all $c, $case: governs($c, $case) & member($case, ApplicableGDPRCases) & member($case, ContractBasisAccepted) -> permits($c, $case, Article6Contract).
assertions.meaning: Applicable contract necessity is a reviewed case-scoped input, not inferred from a promise.

assertions.statement: all $c, $case: governs($c, $case) & member($case, ApplicableGDPRCases) & member($case, LegalObligationBasisAccepted) -> permits($c, $case, Article6LegalObligation).
assertions.meaning: A reviewed statutory processing basis is distinct from any duty derived by this model.
An accepted applicable contract blocks the withdrawal-only erasure ground.
An accepted applicable legal obligation blocks the withdrawal-only erasure ground.

assertions.statement: all $c, $case, $a: governs($c, $case) & member($case, ApplicableGDPRCases) & part($a, $case) & member($a, AccuracyActions) -> obliged($c, $a, Article5).
assertions.meaning: Controller duty for the named accuracy action; no completed action is inferred.

assertions.statement: all $c, $case, $a: governs($c, $case) & member($case, ApplicableGDPRCases) & part($a, $case) & member($a, SecurityActions) -> obliged($c, $a, Article5).
assertions.meaning: Controller duty for the named security action; no completed action is inferred.

assertions.statement: all $c, $case, $a: governs($c, $case) & member($case, ApplicableGDPRCases) & part($a, $case) & member($a, MinimizationActions) -> obliged($c, $a, Article5).
assertions.meaning: Controller duty for the named minimization action; no completed action is inferred.

assertions.statement: all $c, $case, $a: governs($c, $case) & member($case, ApplicableGDPRCases) & member($case, SpecialCategoryCases) & part($a, $case) & member($a, Article9ReviewActions) -> obliged($c, $a, Article9).
assertions.meaning: Special-category processing requires its separately named review; an Article 6 basis is insufficient.

assertions.statement: all $c, $case: governs($c, $case) & member($case, ApplicableGDPRCases) & member($case, SpecialCategoryCases) & member($case, Article9ReviewComplete) & member($case, Article9ConditionAccepted) -> permits($c, $case, Article9Condition).
assertions.meaning: Only the reviewed Article 9 condition is established, not full processing legality.

assertions.statement: all $case, $data, $s, $a: record($case, $data, $s, CaseRegister) & member($case, AccessApplicabilityReviewed) & part($a, $case) & member($a, AccessActions) -> entitled($s, $a, Article15).
assertions.meaning: The subject holds the right to the scoped access response, not a duty to disclose data.

assertions.statement: all $c, $case, $a: governs($c, $case) & member($case, AccessApplicabilityReviewed) & part($a, $case) & member($a, AccessActions) -> obliged($c, $a, Article15).
assertions.meaning: The responsible controller owes the named access response; actual disclosure is separate evidence.

assertions.statement: all $case, $data, $s, $a: record($case, $data, $s, CaseRegister) & member($case, ApplicableGDPRCases) & member($case, ConsentWasBasis) & member($case, ConsentWithdrawalRecorded) & member($case, BasisReviewComplete) & ~member($case, OtherBasisAccepted) & member($case, ExceptionReviewComplete) & ~member($case, ErasureExceptionApplies) & part($a, $case) & member($a, ErasureActions) -> entitled($s, $a, Article17Withdrawal).
assertions.meaning: Article 17(1)(b) within reviewed scope: explicit withdrawal, reviewed absence of another ground, and reviewed exceptions.

assertions.statement: all $c, $case, $a: governs($c, $case) & member($case, ApplicableGDPRCases) & member($case, ConsentWasBasis) & member($case, ConsentWithdrawalRecorded) & member($case, BasisReviewComplete) & ~member($case, OtherBasisAccepted) & member($case, ExceptionReviewComplete) & ~member($case, ErasureExceptionApplies) & part($a, $case) & member($a, ErasureActions) -> obliged($c, $a, Article17Withdrawal).
assertions.meaning: The controller owes erasure; the subject is the right-holder and erasure performance is not inferred.

assertions.statement: all $breach, $case, $authority, $c, $a: record($breach, $case, $authority, BreachRegister) & governs($c, $case) & member($breach, PersonalDataBreaches) & member($breach, RiskReviewComplete) & member($breach, RiskNotUnlikely) & part($a, $breach) & member($a, AuthorityNotificationActions) -> obliged($c, $a, Article33).
assertions.meaning: Reviewed notification trigger for the controller and named authority; time/notification performance is not fabricated.
